name: Systems by Vega
description: Systems by Vega is a B2B operations studio that gets small businesses off spreadsheets and onto custom databases, dashboards, and clean process — built solo, end to end, with real tools instead of an enterprise price tag. The site pairs a storefront with a live, interactive operations console demo, hosted on GitHub Pages with a GitHub-token-based admin for managing the portfolio without touching code.

name: Kingdom Creatives
description: Kingdom Creatives is a faith-driven digital studio that builds and manages church and ministry websites on a WordPress Multisite platform, using Elementor and a custom plugin stack for fast, consistent design. Its clonable site templates and built-in sponsorship program let new ministries launch a professional online presence in a fraction of the usual time and cost.
